attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Lattice Local Rig.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- SetGeo: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- SetParent: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- SetAttrsPosition: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- Local: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature.
- CtrlSize: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 4).
- CtrlColor: choose one option (for example: purple, lightBlue, blue, white).
- Template parent examples: Spine_End_Jnt, Head_Jnt, L_Wrist_Jnt.
- Template attrs-position examples: Vis_Ctrl, L_Eyelids_Scale_Ctrl, L_Brow_Ctrl.

Tips:
- if a field says left/right or mirror, use it to generate the opposite side quickly.
